name: Riya Sharma
text: Booked a 6am Innova to Mumbai. Driver was on time, AC was proper, and the fare matched what we confirmed — no extras at drop.

name: Arjun Deshmukh
text: Outstation sedan for a family trip. Smooth highway ride, neat cab, and clear per-km pricing. Booking again for Diwali.

name: Ananya Patil
text: Sunday evening cab back to Pune. Shared live location with my parents and reached before the time we were quoted.
